privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How SuZu Group collects, uses, shares and protects personal data in SuZu One.
intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Công ty Cổ phần SuZu Group ("SuZu Group", "we", "us") collects, uses, shares and protects personal data in SuZu One, the internal operations platform available at https://suzu.one (the "Service").

SuZu One is an internal tool. It is available only to employees, collaborators and other personnel of SuZu Group and its affiliated companies who have been given a company Google Workspace account on suzu.vn or suzu.group. It is not offered to the public. The public careers pages at https://suzu.one/careers are covered by the privacy notice shown on the application form.

sections.heading: 1. Who is responsible for your data
body: The controller of personal data processed in the Service is Công ty Cổ phần SuZu Group, 265/40 Nơ Trang Long, Bình Lợi Trung, TP. Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam.
If your employment or engagement contract is with another company in the SuZu Group, that company is also responsible for your employment data, and SuZu Group operates the Service on its behalf.
You can reach us about anything in this policy at privacy@suzu.one.

sections.heading: 2. Information we receive from Google
body: Signing in with Google is the only way to use the Service. When you sign in, we ask Google only for the standard sign-in scopes: openid, email and profile. From these we receive:
list: your name and profile picture;
your email address and whether Google has verified it;
your Google account identifier;
the Google Workspace domain your account belongs to (for example suzu.group).
after: We use this information only to authenticate you, to check that your account belongs to an allowed SuZu Group Workspace domain and to a person who currently has access, and to show your name and picture inside the Service. When you open salary and other compensation screens, we ask you to confirm your identity with Google again.

We do not request access to your Gmail, Google Drive, Google Calendar, contacts or any other Google data. The tokens Google issues when you sign in are kept on our servers only to maintain your sign-in and are not used to call any other Google service on your behalf.

sections.heading: 3. Our commitment on Google user data
body: SuZu One's use and transfer of information received from Google APIs adheres to the Google API Services User Data Policy (https://developers.google.com/terms/api-services-user-data-policy), including the Limited Use requirements. In particular:
list: we use Google user data only to provide and secure the sign-in features described above;
we do not sell Google user data, and we do not use or transfer it for advertising, including personalised or retargeted advertising;
we do not use Google user data to determine creditworthiness or for lending purposes;
we do not use Google user data to develop, improve or train generalised artificial intelligence or machine learning models;

no person reads Google user data except where you have agreed, where it is needed for security (for example investigating abuse), where the law requires it, or in aggregated form for internal operations.

sections.heading: 4. Other information in the Service
body: As an HR and work platform, the Service holds information that you, HR, your managers or colleagues enter, or that the Service records while you use it:
list: Identity and contact details: name, date of birth, gender, phone numbers, addresses, identity card or passport details, emergency contacts.
Employment: the company that employs you, your unit, position, manager, contract type and dates, onboarding and offboarding records, documents such as contracts and decisions.

Attendance and leave: check-in and check-out times; when you check in from the app, the location your device reports and your network address at that moment, used only to confirm you are at a company work location; records imported from office time clocks (times and employee codes, not fingerprints or face data); leave balances and requests.
Payroll and compensation: salary, allowances, bonuses, social, health and unemployment insurance details, personal income tax details and dependants, bank account details, payslips.
Performance: objectives, KPIs, reviews and recognition.
Work: tasks, projects, daily plans, comments, files and approvals.
Requests and assets: internal requests and the equipment assigned to you.
Technical and security data: IP address, browser and device type, sign-in and session records, an audit log of actions taken in the Service, and error reports when something goes wrong.
after: Identity numbers, bank details, salary and other compensation, and health information in leave records are treated as restricted data and receive the additional protections described in section 7.

sections.heading: 5. How we use personal data
list: to run the company's HR processes: employee records, attendance, leave, payroll, statutory social insurance and personal income tax, recruitment and performance;
to organise and track work: tasks, projects, requests and approvals;
to share internal knowledge and announcements, and to answer questions from the company knowledge base;
to send you notifications about your work, by email, browser notification or Google Chat;
to keep the Service secure: authentication, access control, audit logging and preventing misuse;
to keep the Service working: monitoring errors and fixing faults;
to meet our obligations under Vietnamese law, including labour, social insurance, tax and accounting law.
after: We process personal data on the bases Vietnamese personal data protection law provides: to perform your labour or engagement contract, to comply with legal obligations, with your consent where consent is required, and otherwise as permitted by law. We do not use personal data in the Service for advertising and we do not sell it.

sections.heading: 6. Who can see your data inside the company
body: Access in the Service is based on roles and denied by default. Each person sees only what their role needs: you see your own records and payslips; HR, finance and managers see what their responsibilities require. Line managers never see their team members' salaries or other compensation. Opening compensation screens requires re-confirming your identity with Google, and access to restricted data is recorded in an audit log that cannot be altered.

sections.heading: 7. How we protect personal data
list: all traffic to the Service is encrypted in transit (HTTPS);
restricted and compensation fields are additionally encrypted in the database with keys held separately from the data;
the database is not reachable through any public data interface, and file storage is private;
role-based access control, re-authentication for sensitive screens and an append-only audit log;
sessions expire after seven days and can be revoked immediately when someone's access ends.
after: No system is perfectly secure. If a personal data breach occurs, we will act to contain it and notify the affected people and the authorities as Vietnamese law requires.

sections.heading: 8. Service providers we share data with
body: We do not sell personal data. We share it only with the providers that run parts of the Service for us, under contracts that limit their use of it to providing their service:
list: Vercel Inc. — application hosting;
Supabase Inc. — database and private file storage, hosted in Singapore;
Upstash Inc. — a cache for configuration and reference data (never salary or other sensitive personal data);
Resend — delivery of emails the Service sends;
Functional Software Inc. (Sentry) — error monitoring;
Google LLC — Google Workspace sign-in, and Google Chat and Google Calendar notifications and meetings where the company has enabled them;
Anthropic PBC and Voyage AI — the assistant and knowledge base search, where the company has enabled them; they receive the question asked and the knowledge base content needed to answer it.
after: We also disclose personal data where the law requires it — for example to the tax authority, the social insurance agency, or banks paying salaries — and, if SuZu Group or a group company is reorganised, merged or sold, to the successor, under the same protections.

sections.heading: 9. Transfers outside Vietnam
body: The Service's database and files are hosted in Singapore, and some providers listed above may process data in other countries, including the United States. We transfer personal data abroad only as needed to provide the Service and take the steps Vietnamese law requires for cross-border transfers of personal data.

sections.heading: 10. How long we keep data
list: Your sign-in account and Google identifiers: while you have access to the Service; they are removed when your access ends and you ask us to delete them, or when your records are deleted.
Employment, attendance and leave records: for the duration of your employment and afterwards for as long as labour and social insurance law requires.
Payroll, tax and accounting records: for the periods required by Vietnamese tax and accounting law (up to ten years).
Audit logs: for as long as needed for security and to demonstrate compliance.
Sessions: seven days from the last activity. Error reports: a limited period, after which they are deleted automatically.
after: When a retention period ends, we delete the data or make it anonymous.

sections.heading: 11. Your rights
body: Under Vietnamese personal data protection law you may, subject to the conditions the law sets:
list: know how your personal data is processed, and access and obtain a copy of it;
ask us to correct inaccurate data — many details can be corrected directly from your profile in the Service;
ask us to delete your data, or restrict or object to its processing;
withdraw consent you have given, without affecting processing already carried out;
complain to the competent authority, the Ministry of Public Security of Vietnam.
after: To exercise these rights, email privacy@suzu.one or contact HR. We will respond within the time Vietnamese law requires. Some data must be kept by law even when you ask us to delete it; if so, we will tell you what and why.

sections.heading: 12. Revoking Google access and deleting your data
body: You can remove SuZu One's access to your Google account at any time at https://myaccount.google.com/permissions. You will then no longer be able to sign in.

To have your sign-in account and the information we received from Google deleted, email privacy@suzu.one from your company account. We will delete it within 30 days, except for records the law requires us to keep, which are deleted when their retention period ends.

sections.heading: 13. Cookies and local storage
body: The Service uses only the cookies it needs to work: a session cookie that keeps you signed in, short-lived cookies that protect the Google sign-in process, and a cookie that remembers your language. Your browser also stores interface preferences, such as whether the sidebar is collapsed. We do not use advertising or third-party tracking cookies.

sections.heading: 14. Children
body: The Service is for SuZu Group personnel and is not directed at children. The only information about children it holds is what employees provide about their dependants for personal income tax and insurance purposes.

sections.heading: 15. Changes to this policy
body: We may update this policy. The date at the top shows when it last changed. If we make material changes, we will tell users in the Service before they take effect.

sections.heading: 16. Contact
body: Công ty Cổ phần SuZu Group, 265/40 Nơ Trang Long, Bình Lợi Trung, TP. Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam. Email: privacy@suzu.one.

welcome.title: Hi {name}, welcome to SuZu One!
welcome.body: SuZu One is where you check in, request leave, follow your work, read your payslips and look up company policies — all in one place. The next few steps show what you'll do day to day. It takes about two minutes.
welcome.tip: You can open each page while you read. The guide shrinks into the corner and waits for you.

today.title: Today — where every day starts
today.body: After you sign in you land on Today: what you planned, what's due and what's waiting for you. Plan your day and log your time right there.
today.tip: Press Ctrl + K (⌘ + K on a Mac) to find a task or jump to any page.

checkIn.title: Check in / check out
checkIn.body: Check in from your phone or computer: tap Check in when you start work and Check out when you finish. The time comes from the system's clock, and your browser may ask for your location to confirm you're at work.
checkIn.tip: Forgot to check in? Send an adjustment request from Attendance for your manager to approve.

me.title: My profile
me.body: See what the company holds about you: your position, your manager, your personal details and the equipment you've been given. Check it carefully in your first week.
me.tip: Something wrong? Send a change request from the page and HR will review it.

leave.title: Leave
leave.body: See how many days you have left and send a leave request. It goes straight to your approver, and you're notified when it's decided.
leave.tip: Look at the leave calendar before picking dates, so you don't overlap with teammates.

tasks.title: My work
tasks.body: Everything that needs you is in one inbox: tasks assigned to you, deliverables to review, requests to approve and hand-offs to accept. The number in the sidebar tells you how many are left.
tasks.tip: My notifications tells you when new work arrives or one of your requests is decided.

daily.title: Daily plan & report
daily.body: At the start of the day, pick what you'll work on; at the end, note what you did and how long it took. Your past reports are on this page.
daily.tip: Start the timer on Today when you begin a task, so you don't have to remember at the end of the day.

payslips.title: Payslips
payslips.body: Your monthly payslip appears here once it's issued. Only you can see your payslips.
payslips.tip: To protect pay information, you'll be asked to confirm your Google account again before a payslip opens.

kb.title: Knowledge base & Ask SuZu
kb.body: Company policies, procedures and how-tos live in the Knowledge base. Got a question like “How many days of leave do I get a year?” — ask SuZu, which answers from the documents you're allowed to read.
kb.tip: Required reading is sent to you with a request to confirm you've read it.

finish.title: You're all set!
finish.body: Those are the essentials. Press “I'm done” to close the guide for good. Not finished yet? Choose “Remind me later” and it opens again next time you sign in.
finish.tip: Need help? Ask your manager or HR.
